verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਿਲਿ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਾਸੁ ਲੀਜੀਅਤਿ ਕੁਸਮ ਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਫੁਲੇਲ ਜਤਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise til baas baas leejeeat kusam sai taa(n) te hot hai fulel jatan kai jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as fragrance is taken from flowers and then it is put in sesame that with some effort yields scented oil.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਉਟਾਇ ਦੂਧ ਜਾਵਨ ਜਮਾਇ ਮਥਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਸਹਤਿ ਘ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau aauTai dhoodh jaavan jamai math sa(n)jam sahat ghirat pragaT kai maaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as milk is boiled, converted to curd and then churned yields butter, with some more effort even clarified butter (Ghee) is obtained.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੂਆ ਖੋਦ ਕੈ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਧਸਾਇ ਕੌਰੀ ਲਾਜੁ ਕੈ ਬਹਾਇ ਡੋਲਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਜਲੁ ਆਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kooaa khodh kai basudhaa dhasai kauaree laaj kai bahai ddol kaadd jal aaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as earth is excavated to dig a well and thereafter (on appearance of water) the side walls of the well are lined, then water is pulled out with the help of rope and bucket.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਤੈਸੇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੀਐ ॥੫੩੫॥
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes taise bhaavanee bhagat bhai ghaT ghaT pooran braham pahichaaneeaai ||535||

en.bdb: Similarly, if the sermon of the True Guru is practiced diligently, with love and devotion, with every breath, the Lord-God becomes conspicuously permeated in every living being.  (535)
